exposure: type of financing for hospital admission (public/private)
outcome: Adequacy of process indicators for HIV management (prenatal care coverage, HIV testing coverage, antiretroviral treatment registration, viral load test registration)
cohort: The study included 1,923 pregnant women in the state of Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
finding: The study identified missed opportunities in the management of pregnant women with HIV in both public and private services in Rio de Janeiro, with an estimated HIV prevalence of 0.79%.
